name: Mukhyamantri Bal Poshan Yojana
benefit: Under the scheme, pre-school children (aged 3 to 6 years) are provided with eggs twice a week and banana chips twice a week.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. Children aged 3 to 6 years are eligible to receive nutritious food under this scheme.
